 {"step":9,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_error","line":2054,"var":"opt_state->top_ctx","code":"longjmp(opt_state->top_ctx, 1);","note":"a crafted filter can drive the optimizer into an exceptional path that re-enters cleanup after partial frees, producing the double-free crash"}
